08Project process>>>

How a projectmoves throughCommnet

One engineering team owns the job from the first site survey to the long-term SLA

1. Consultation

Site survey, requirement capture and regulatory mapping (SIRA, ADMCC, ISO 27001).

2. Design

Architecture, BoQ and drawings, reviewed with the client and consultant.

3. Engineering

Detailed engineering from Chennai: racks, containment, power and network.

4. Implementation

Certified field teams install, terminate and label to industry standard.

5. Testing

Fluke certification, commissioning and authority approvals at go-live.

6. Support

AMC, multi-year SLAs and 8-year managed infrastructure contracts.

Indicative programme for a mid-size fit-out (about 14 weeks to go-live). Durations scale with scope; testing overlaps the final weeks of implementation so approvals land at go-live.
